messages:
Alex: Customer acct-42 just escalated — function invocation to our 'search_tool' is failing with a schema validation error (400). They say the same payload used to work last week. Repro + logs below. Can eng-runtime or eng-ml take a look?

Alex: Error snippet from prod: 
```
error: schema_validation_failed
details: expected 'filters' to be object, got array
request_id: rq_0b12c34d
status: 400
```

Alex: Minimal repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-search-1","tool":"search_tool","input":"find docs about batching","args":{"filters":[{"tag":"infra"}]}}'
```

Jing: ack — I filed the escalation with the customer and asked for the full request_id/headers. Sending request_id to eng.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice — eng-runtime v1.14.3 deployed to hosted-prod at 2026-11-09T08:53:12Z (sha: a1b2c3d).

Priya: @Mateo @Alex quick q: is this failing only for search_tool or do other function tools also return a 400? Also is it limited to that model (rwd-search-1) or all models?

Alex: Only reported for search_tool so far, on rwd-search-1 and a couple of our dedicated pools. Customer says it started after last week's runtime deploy (per deploy-bot timing). Request id is rq_0b12c34d, full headers below: 
```
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
User-Agent: curl/7.85.0
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: rq_0b12c34d
```

Mateo: I ran the internal tool-calling regression evals this morning and I see a failing golden test: `tool_call/schema_compatibility/filters_array_vs_object`. CI job GH-Actions #4821 shows failures starting at the same commit as the runtime deploy. Failing assert: our schema normalizer now enforces `filters` to be object. Previously we accepted arrays and coerced them.

Mateo: Failing test output excerpt:
```
- expected: {filters: {tag: "infra"}}
- got: {filters: [{tag: "infra"}]}
AssertionError: schema mismatch in function call payload
```

Priya: That matches the customer report. Sounds like a stricter normalization landed in v1.14.3. Can we patch a compatibility shim? Rolling back a runtime deploy would be heavier.

Mateo: Short-term: I can add a compatibility layer in the function-call parser to accept arrays for `filters` and coerce to object if array length==1. Long-term: update the eval suite to include more golden prompts that cover this shape mismatch and add a CI gate.

Alex: Customer wants a repro-able mitigation while you patch (they need to ship). Any chance we can return a 200 with a warning for now? Or a proxy shim on our side?

Mateo: We can hotfix runtime today to treat single-element filter arrays as legacy and return a 200 + `warning: legacy_filters_array_normalized`. I'll open PR now and trigger a small canary.

Jing: I'll tell the customer we'll have a temporary workaround within the day and ask them to retry with the same payload.

Priya: Plan: Mateo will submit patch and @eng-runtime oncall will canary to 5% in the next hour. If green, promote and then we notify support to confirm with customer. If fails, rollback to v1.14.2. I'll standby for the canary metrics (errors/latency).

Mateo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/1214 (adds legacy filter coercion + test). Triggered GH-Actions job. CI link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/actions/runs/9999999.

deploy-bot: GH Actions job started for PR #1214 — canary build queued.

Alex: Thanks. Once canary is up I'll ask the customer to retry and share results. Also please add a regression test to evals: golden prompt with `filters` as an array and as object.

Mateo: Will do — adding two golden cases and updating the eval CI to block deploys if schema_compat tests regress.

Jing: Customer update queued: "We identified an incompatibility introduced in last runtime deploy; engineering is deploying a temporary compatibility fix and will confirm shortly." :thumbsup:

Priya: tagging follow-ups: eng-runtime to monitor canary errors (span rate, 400s). eng-ml/evals to expand golden test coverage. support to verify with the customer once canary promoted.

Alex: closing loop in thread when customer confirms. Thanks everyone.
